data.name: Infernal Gate
data.detailed_description:
Infernal Gate

Infernal Gate is a dungeon crawler and a Doom shooter where you must fight your way through a perilous underworld. Master a massive arsenal and carefully manage your hard-earned loot to survive dynamic enemy encounters and defeat colossal bosses.

Key Gameplay Features:

  • Immersive Story Campaign: Experience a structured, chapter-based narrative featuring a deep dialogue system that pulls you into the dark lore of the underworld.

  • Tactical, Mixed Combat: Adapt to brutal, evolving enemies by seamlessly combining customizable ranged firearms, heavy melee weapons, and tactical throwables to suit your playstyle.

  • Loot & Inventory Management: Scavenge for survival. Utilize an extensive loot system to build your ideal loadout, requiring strategic inventory organization and careful resource planning before major encounters.

  • Epic Boss Fights: Put your customized weapon builds and reflexes to the test against massive underworld guardians blocking your progression.

  • Estimated Playtime: The overarching story offers approximately 2 to 3 hours of gameplay.

  • Additional Content: Campaign Mode, Survival Arena, and New Game+ are in development.

data.short_description: Dive into Infernal Gate and its engaging Story Mode, driven by a rich dialogue system. Annihilate enemies using a highly complex system of ranged, melee, and throwable weapons. Master your loadout with a deep inventory system to adapt and survive every brutal encounter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-8100 / Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 750 Ti / RX 560 / Intel UHD 630
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 / RX 580 / RTX 2060
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game is a mature, extremely graphic game containing frequent intense violence, gore, adult themes, frightening psychological horror, and general mature content, including non-graphic cartoon/fantasy violence and derogatory language.
